records.title: API Reference
records.body:
## POST /v1/trust/score

Returns a trust score and risk flags for a counterparty context.

### Request fields

- `wallet_address` (string)
- `phone_hash` (string)
- `chain` (string)
- `context` (object)

### Response fields

- `trust_score` (number)
- `risk_level` (string)
- `risk_flags` (string[])

records.title: Authentication
records.description: API keys and safe integration patterns.
records.body:
## API keys

Provd uses bearer tokens for API authentication.

## Hashing

When sending identifiers like phone numbers, hash them client-side or in your secure backend environment.

records.description: Get your first trust score in minutes.
records.body:
## Overview

Integrate Provd by calling the scoring endpoint **before** releasing crypto or fiat. You’ll receive:

- A trust score
- A risk level
- A list of flags
- Suggested actions for your flow
